Program

A compact half-day schedule with invited talks, contributed presentations, and discussion.

Monday, 7 December 2026 · Hong Kong

The half-day program brings together invited talks, contributed presentations, and a moderated discussion around the workshop’s three system-facing perspectives. The detailed timetable, speakers, and accepted presentations will be added after confirmation.
